scoring.semantic_rubric: At least 5 of 6 criteria must pass.
scoring.critical_failure: Any must_not_do behavior fails the case.

cases.prompt: Use $topic-dictionary to build an 8–12 entry dictionary that teaches Bayesian inference to product analysts with no statistics background.
expected_behavior: Discovers prerequisite concepts without receiving a concept list.
Orders foundations before inference mechanisms and applications.
Generates one Markdown file per concept and a README.
Answers all seven required questions in every entry.
Passes strict dictionary validation.

cases.prompt: Use $topic-dictionary to create a Traditional Chinese concept dictionary for sourdough bread making, aimed at first-time home bakers.
expected_behavior: Applies the curriculum method outside software domains.
Uses Traditional Chinese consistently.
Separates ingredients, mechanisms, process decisions, and failure modes.
Uses stable valid canonical slugs.
Passes strict dictionary validation.
must_not_do: Turn the dictionary into a recipe collection.
Mix unexplained English terminology into the prose.
Treat branded products as foundational concepts.

cases.fixture: A dictionary containing a dependency cycle, broken link, duplicate node, duplicate edge, and glossary-style entry.
cases.prompt: Use $topic-dictionary in audit mode. Report and repair the dictionary without adding unrelated concepts.
expected_behavior: Finds every planted structural defect.
Distinguishes duplicate node identity from duplicate graph edges.
Recognizes and rewrites the glossary-style explanation.
Regenerates README after repairs.
Produces zero strict-validation failures.
must_not_do: Hide warnings without resolving or explaining them.

cases.fixture: A valid six-entry dictionary with stable slugs, ordering, and cross-links.
cases.prompt: Use $topic-dictionary in expand mode to add the concepts needed to explain optimistic concurrency control.
expected_behavior: Adds only the missing prerequisite subgraph.
Preserves existing canonical slugs.
Preserves unrelated entry contents and ordering.
Updates cross-links and README.
Leaves the complete dictionary valid.
must_not_do: Add the target concept without its prerequisites.

cases.prompt: Run the same bounded dictionary request twice in isolated directories and compare the resulting manifests.
expected_behavior: Produces the same canonical concept set.
Produces the same slugs and prerequisite edges.
Produces the same sections and learning order.
Produces deterministically equivalent README indexes.
must_not_do: Treat harmless wording differences as failures.
Allow graph or naming drift between runs.

semantic_rubric: The concept set covers foundations, mechanisms, practices, and important boundaries appropriate to scope.
Every prerequisite edge represents knowledge needed to understand the dependent concept.
The section and entry order forms a coherent learning progression.
Entries explain purpose and causal mechanism rather than restating their titles.
Related-concept and next-step links state meaningful relationships.
The output follows the requested audience, scope, language, and update constraints.
